<details>
<summary>Calculation and record checks</summary>

Counting averages divide summed totals by appearances; DNPs do not enter that denominator. Shooting percentages divide summed makes by summed attempts; zero attempts is N/A. Mark coverage gaps independently of games played. Keep each game in one owning record, retain team stints, and separate competitions. Link closed source games, full stat detail and earned award decisions. No review action changes a box score or invents an award.

</details>
